legion.invitationPerimee: This link has already been used or has expired. Ask for a new one.

legion.connecteurMesuresOff: The whole marketplace's numbers. Finjaro team only.

legion.bilanAgents: {{total}} agents · {{allumes}} on · {{choisis}} picked their own face
legion.choisirAide: {{n}} haven't picked yet. They will read their own role and decide their face and character themselves. Only agents that are on will run.
legion.chercherQuelquun: Search an agent, a role, a room…

legion.niveauAutonomie: How far it goes without asking
legion.videPrive: Nothing yet between you and {{nom}}. Write.
legion.ilDort: {{nom}} is off and won't answer. Turn them on.
legion.claudeRepondra: {{nom}} will reply in person on the next visit to Léo.
legion.remplacerPhoto: Replace their real photo with a drawing? The photo is kept; Claude can restore it.
legion.depenseAide: Above the cap, agents stop until next month. The real bill is in Google AI Studio.
legion.membresAide: Agents of the department are in by default. Add anyone else you want.
legion.aucuneCompetence: No skills yet. Let them choose, or search for one.
legion.equipesFaits: {{n}} agents picked their skills. Their choices are in their rooms.
legion.sansCompetence: {{n}} agents have no skill yet. Each can pick the 3 expert playbooks that will help them most.
legion.memoireExplication: When you give an instruction meant to last, the agent keeps it here. Everyone rereads it before answering.
legion.photosCoutent: Each one describes the face they want and we generate it. No real person is used. Note: generating an image costs money, unlike the drawing.
legion.heroTexte: {{departements}} departments, {{agents}} agents, {{allumes}} on right now. Give an order, open a room, or message someone directly.
legion.partiellementEnVeille: Part of the team is asleep
legion.directiveAide: The department's agent receives it and answers
legion.directivePlaceholder: e.g. tell me why visitors don't order, and what you would change
legion.directive1: The three decisions waiting for me
legion.directive3: One idea to bring in buyers
legion.directive4: Where the money stands this week
legion.departementsAide: Open a room, or message the lead directly
legion.porteTitre2: and the teams working in them.
legion.porteTexte: Each company has its departments, rooms and agents — with a face, a character and a switch. Step into one, or found another.
legion.aucuneAide: Pick a model, a headcount, and the team appears.
legion.connecteurAssistantAide: Your assistant reads your channels, tasks and roadmap, and can write in a channel in your name — with your rights, nothing more. Create a token, paste the address into your assistant (“no authentication” connector).
legion.jetonUneFois: Copy this address now: it will not be shown again.
legion.tropDeJetons: Five tokens at most: revoke one first.

reunion.aide: Each one gives a position from their own trade, then they challenge each other on substance. The chair writes the minutes: what is decided, what is dropped and why, the disagreements, and what you need to decide. You can step in at any time.
reunion.sujetPlaceholder: E.g.: how do we find our first twenty customers before the end of the month?
reunion.conclusionDemandee: Noted: the chair is writing the minutes from what has been said.
reunion.interventionNotee: Meeting in progress: the next speaker answers you first.
reunion.recherche: Look up facts on the internet before starting
reunion.rechercheAide: One search, done once, read by every participant; its sources show under the minutes.

debat.aide: Everyone states a position from their field, then they challenge each other. The minutes say what is decided, dropped, what divides, and what you decide.
debat.exemple: E.g.: how do we find our first twenty customers before the end of the month?

vote.aide: A debate, then everyone votes for, against or abstains on the proposal. Léo counts, not an agent. The vote informs: you decide.
vote.exemple: E.g.: should we replace agent X, whose deliverables are too thin?

avocat.aide: One participant must challenge the dominant view every round, even if they would agree. Unanswered objections stay in the minutes.
avocat.exemple: E.g.: launching our paid plan in November

presse.aide: The chair is the spokesperson; the others play journalists and ask the hard questions. You get the solid answers, the phrases to avoid and what to prepare.
presse.exemple: E.g.: we launch our app — questions about payment security

clients.aide: Agents play typical customers, each a different profile; the chair moderates. What they expect, what makes them hesitate — to check with real customers afterwards.
clients.exemple: E.g.: why would a customer add an item to the cart without ordering?

negociation.aide: One agent plays the other side (supplier, partner, big client); the others negotiate for you. Possible agreements, concessions not to make.
negociation.exemple: E.g.: negotiating delivery fees with a carrier

investisseurs.aide: Agents play investors reviewing your case; the chair represents the company. In round two, each gives a verdict.
investisseurs.exemple: E.g.: our case for a first fundraising round

crise.aide: The topic is a crisis scenario. Each says what their field does in the first hour and the first day; the action plan comes out in order, with who does what.
crise.exemple: E.g.: the site goes down on a Saturday night during a promotion

etsi.aide: Agents reread what was planned and decided, and compare with another path: what would have changed, and the lesson for what comes next.
etsi.exemple: E.g.: what if we had started with services rather than fashion?

retro.aide: From the last seven days' tasks: what we keep, what we stop, and one concrete thing to change.

budget.aide: Each lead defends priorities and says what they can give up — in shares and priorities, no invented amounts. You set the amounts.
budget.exemple: E.g.: how to split this quarter's budget

impact.aide: The effects of a decision on customers, teams, society, the law and the environment; underestimated risks, and safeguards to decide.
impact.exemple: E.g.: letting an agent answer customers alone at night

appel.parle: {{nom}} is answering — tap the mic to interrupt
appel.pasDeMicro: This browser gives no access to the microphone.
appel.pasDeReponse: No answer this time. Try again.

legion.fichierNonPris: Excel, CSV, PDF or text only.

renfort.titre: Reinforce a team, or bring in an expert
renfort.aide_renfort: Describe the team: how many people, what they do, what overflows. Léo proposes agents that take the repetitive work; people keep the complex and relational work.
renfort.aide_expert: Pick an expert and describe the mission. They come with their methods, deliver on the task board, and can switch off on their own at the end.
renfort.descriptionExemple: E.g.: 20 people in customer service. They answer emails and WhatsApp messages, track deliveries, handle returns and chase unpaid invoices.
renfort.objectifExemple: E.g.: review our quarterly expenses, flag what is drifting, and write a report at the end.
renfort.finAide: With a date, they are temps: they switch off on their own the next morning and say so in the room.
renfort.cherche: Léo is putting the team together…
renfort.rien: No proposal this time. Try again.
renfort.engages: {{n}} agent(s) join the team, with their first tasks on the board.

legion.jamaisEx: E.g.: promise a refund; talk about salaries; send anything without approval
legion.jamaisDefaut: nothing specified: house rules and Léo rules apply (nothing sent or changed without your click).
legion.modeleAuto: Auto — DeepSeek, then Kimi, then Gemini (recommended)
legion.modeleChoisiAide: The whole team works with this model. If it doesn’t answer or its key isn’t set, Léo moves to the next one in Auto rather than leaving the agents silent.
legion.moteurAutoAide: Auto: DeepSeek first, Kimi if it doesn’t answer, then Gemini. The setting applies to the whole team.
legion.moteurSeulAide: The whole team speaks with this engine only. If its key isn’t set, Léo falls back to Auto rather than leaving the agents silent.
legion.finMissionAide: Empty: they stay. A date: they switch off on their own the next morning, and say so.
legion.catalogueChercher: Search {{n}} roles (e.g. payroll, audit, social media)
legion.outilsAide: Agents deliver in these formats: a spreadsheet for Excel, a short message for WhatsApp…

consigne.contexteTexte: The company project and roadmap; the latest room messages and its memory; what was said elsewhere that concerns them; their open tasks and their department plan; the team (who is on).
consigne.fixesTexte: Answer the question asked, in the message’s language; deliver rather than offer; warm expert tone; no invented figure or work; never claim something is done when it is not (only your “Confirm” button runs an action); ask a real question when something is missing. A review checks figures before sending.
consigne.titre: What they receive before each answer

docs.aide: Terms of sale, FAQ, prices, procedures: agents answer from them and cite their source; when the answer is not there, they say so. Files are readable through their link: do not put customers’ personal data in them.
docs.deposer: Upload a document (PDF, Excel, CSV, text)
docs.formats: PDF, Excel, CSV or text only.
docs.coller: Or paste a text here (FAQ, terms, procedure…)
docs.retirerConfirmer: Remove “{{titre}}”? Agents will stop using it.
docs.triAide: Paste a message you received (email, WhatsApp): Léo says whether it is a customer request and drafts the answer from your documents. Nothing is sent without you.
docs.triSansDocs: Paste a message you received: Léo sorts it. Upload your documents first so the answer relies on them.
docs.triExemple: E.g.: Hello, my order still hasn’t arrived, can I get a refund?

vestiaire.aide: A link (GitHub repository, article, Notion page, video) or a text: Mentor, the training agent, turns it into a note, files it in these documents and suggests skills for the agents it concerns. Nothing is given to an agent until you click “Add skill”.
vestiaire.lien: https://… (GitHub repository, article, Notion page, video)
vestiaire.texte: Or paste a text — or a few words to go with the link
vestiaire.patience: This can take a minute: the resource is read, then the note is written.
vestiaire.aucune: No skill suggested: too little could be read, or nothing helps the team. The note says why.
vestiaire.enlever: Do not give it to this agent
vestiaire.remettre: Give it to this agent too
vestiaire.rienSansClic: Suggestions only: each skill is given only after you click “Add skill”. Tap a name to remove it.

legion.connecteurComptaBranchee: “{{nom}}” is connected: month summary, sales, expenses, unpaid amounts.
legion.connecteurSansCompta: You don’t have a Finjaro Accounting workspace yet.
legion.connecteurComptaAide: Agents read the TOTALS of your books: a month’s summary, sales, expenses by category, what is still to be collected and paid — never a customer’s name or a single line. If you leave this workspace, they read nothing more.
legion.plafondIA: This month's AI budget is used up. The agents will resume as soon as it is raised.
legion.googleSature: Google's models are overloaded right now. Try again in a minute.
legion.reessaie: A small connection problem with the models. Try again in a moment.

rapport.aide: It arrives on its own every evening in this room. Here, you ask for it now.
rapport.semaineAide: The last seven days, to listen to
rapport.moisAide: Last month: cost, rereads, confirmed actions
rapport.enCours: The director is writing the report…
rapport.plafond: Monthly cap reached: no AI-written report today.

tdb.aideCompte: Everything is counted in the database: messages, deliverables, tasks, rereads. No score is made up, and no model grades the agents.
tdb.aideDifficulte: open work and not a word for three days, or two blocked tasks, or the monthly budget reached.
tdb.aideSurveiller: one blocked task, a deliverable waiting for your review for more than two days, a task untouched for seven days, more send-backs than approvals, the reread correcting at least half of its replies, or 80% of the budget.
tdb.aideReputation: Approved: the deliverables you approved, out of approved + sent back, over the period.
tdb.aideCout: Cost per agent is recorded on each of its messages since 24/09: before, only the company total was known. It is an estimate based on Google's public prices.

r.silence: Open work, and not a word for three days
r.budgetAtteint: Monthly budget reached: no more work until next month
r.revueLongue: {{n}} deliverable(s) waiting for your review for more than two days
r.renvois: More deliverables sent back than approved
r.corrections: The reread corrected {{c}} of its {{r}} reread replies

tdb.aucuneEtape: None of the {{n}} roadmap milestones is ticked yet.
tdb.pasDeFeuille: No roadmap yet: its ticked milestones will become trophies.

cinqValides.regle: At least five deliverables approved by you.

sansFaute.regle: At least ten replies reread over the period, none corrected.

debloqueur.regle: Unblocked a task by answering what was missing.

relais.regle: Passed a task to a colleague along with its deliverable.

assidu.regle: Worked on at least five different days over the period.

tdb.voteBouton: Gather the team: should they be replaced?
tdb.voteTropPeu: This vote needs at least two other agents switched on.
tdb.voteSujet: Should we replace {{nom}} ({{poste}})? What we see: {{raisons}}. Vote, saying why and what would change your mind.

legion.interrupteurDepartement: Switch all of {{nom}} on or off

memoireAgent.aide: What belongs to them alone: their deliverables, the lessons from deliverables you sent back, what you liked. Before replying or delivering, they recall the closest to what is asked.
memoireAgent.vide: Nothing yet: their memory fills up with their deliverables, your send-backs and your encouragement.
memoireAgent.bravoPlaceholder: What you liked about their work…

emprunter.fait_one: {{count}} skill from {{nom}} fetched from its source.
emprunter.fait_other: {{count}} skills from {{nom}} fetched from their source.

examen.enCours: Exam in progress… (one to two minutes)

appris.attente: Rigo will examine it on Monday. Not to wait: « Run the exam ».

importer.competences_one: {{count}} skill will be fetched from its source after creation.
importer.competences_other: {{count}} skills will be fetched from their source after creation.

conteste.consigne: review {{nom}}'s deliverable above with your professional eye. If there is a real problem (unsourced figure, unproven conclusion, broken rule, missed risk), say exactly what and what should change; otherwise just say you have nothing to add.

missions.aide: Ready-made missions: choose who does it, launch it once, or have it come back on its own every week, month or year. It lands on the agent's board, to be taken on their next work day.
missions.lancee: On {{nom}}'s board: to be taken on their next work day.
missions.activee: On {{nom}}'s board, and it will come back on its own.

vues.legende: Gold and moving: the agent wrote in the last ten minutes. Greyed: switched off. What moves is what they really do.
vues.pasDeProjet: The project is not described yet.

diapo.mesureNote: Counted in Léo. No financial figure is written here until it is measured.

vues.presentationNote: Made from what is in Léo: the project, the team, the plan, the roadmap, what is measured. Arrow keys to move.
vues.aucuneIdee: No idea yet. Post the first one.
vues.wikiVide: The wiki is not written yet: it fills up every Friday, or now with the button.
vues.wikiAide: “What we decided” is written by the director from decisions and minutes; “Who does what” and “How we work” come from the database. Agents reread “What we decided” before replying.

tache.aide: /tache text — a task on the board

regle.aide: /regle text — a rule for the whole team

flux.reunionTicket: A new ticket opens a meeting
flux.reunionTicketAide: Every hour, Léo checks the repository's tickets; a NEW ticket opens a meeting (what is it, how serious, who takes it, what do we answer). One per hour; older tickets open nothing.
flux.rssAide: Every hour, never-seen articles from your feeds (5 at most) are posted as a list in the room, with their links. No model is called: nothing is charged. To follow your app's App Store reviews: https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/id=YOUR_ID/sortBy=mostRecent/xml (Google Play has no public feed).
flux.linearBranche: Connected (team: {{equipe}}): agents see open tickets, read-only.
flux.ticketsAide: Agents read open tickets when asked about code, tickets or priorities. The token goes to the vault and is never shown again.

securite.rolesAide: A reader sees every room, task and the dashboard, but writes nothing and cannot change agents. The database enforces it, not just the screen.
securite.journalAide: Every decision, minutes, deliverable and confirmed action leaves a signed fingerprint, chained to the previous one. Nothing in it can be changed or deleted; “Verify” recomputes everything and says whether a message was edited afterwards.
securite.rupture: The chain is broken: an entry no longer follows the previous one.
securite.vide: Empty so far: the first decision will open it.
securite.lecteurNote: You are a reader in this company: you see everything, you don't write. The owner can change your role.
securite.intact_one: ✓ {{count}} entry: the chain is intact, the signature is valid, no message was edited.
securite.intact_other: ✓ {{count}} entries: the chain is intact, signatures are valid, no message was edited.
securite.marcheAide: The country where the company mainly sells: agents adapt currency, examples, holidays and legal framework. Without a choice, they assume no country.

horsLigne.enAttente: Offline: your message is waiting on this device and will be sent as soon as the network is back.
horsLigne.partis_one: Back online: {{count}} waiting message was sent.
horsLigne.partis_other: Back online: {{count}} waiting messages were sent.

atelier.modeAide_demander: The agent reads freely; every edit and every command waits for your approval.
atelier.modeAide_reflechir: The agent only reads and proposes a plan. Nothing is changed.
atelier.coutDetail: Model: {{modele}} · Machine: {{machine}} (upper estimate) · {{appels}} calls. Published prices, in US dollars.
atelier.modificationsAide: Since the start of the session. Green is added, red is removed.
atelier.aucuneModification: No changes since the start of the session.
atelier.nouvelleSessionConfirmer: Start a new session? The conversation starts over; files and the log stay.
atelier.choisisUnFichier: Pick a file in the tree to read or edit it.
atelier.accueil: Tell the Coder what you want to build or change. It reads the project freely, but every edit and every command waits for your approval. Nothing goes out to the internet: the project only leaves through the .zip export.
atelier.ecris: Write your request… (Ctrl + Enter to send)
atelier.toujoursCommande: Always for this command in this project
atelier.toujoursFichier: Always for this file in this project
atelier.horsLigne: The workshop is not responding. Check your connection, then try again.
atelier.pasEnLigne: The workshop is not online yet: its server (finjaro-atelier) must first be set up on Cloudflare.
atelier.reserve: The workshop is reserved for now.
atelier.connexion: Sign in to Léo to open the workshop.
atelier.suivreAide: The editor opens the file the agent is working on by itself, and you watch it type.
atelier.apercuVide: No web page to show yet (it needs an index.html file). For a Python program, the agent runs it and the result shows up in the conversation.
atelier.rejoueAide: {{nom}} wrote the whole proposal at once; the editor replays it letter by letter so you can see what changes. Nothing is saved until you agree.
atelier.consoleVide: The console: every move the agent makes will show up here, live.
atelier.joindre: Attach a file (it goes into the project)
atelier.jointTropGros: File too large (1 MB max for now).
atelier.jointBinaire: “{{nom}}” is not a text file: Excel, PDF and images are coming to the workshop soon.
atelier.jointMention: (Attached file: {{nom}} — it is in the project.)
atelier.ouvrirAPart: Open the page on its own, full size
atelier.modeAide_accepter: Files are written without asking; commands wait for your OK.
atelier.modeAide_auto: The agent writes and runs commands without asking, inside its sandbox only. Dangerous actions stay refused; nothing leaves the sandbox without Confirm.
atelier.toutAutoriserAide: Switch to “Allow all” for the rest (you can switch back at the top anytime), and allow this action.
atelier.terminalVide: Type a command below: it runs in the project sandbox (e.g. ls, node tests.js, python3 main.py).
atelier.paletteAide: Type a file or an action… (">" for actions only)
atelier.ecritIci: The agent is writing in this file
atelier.etat_en_attente: A change is waiting for your approval

droits.modifierAide: Can write code and run commands in the code workshop, within the mode you choose.

immeuble.accueil: Your company right now: {{n}} at work. Click someone to see them.
immeuble.accueilVide: No arrivals in the last two days.
immeuble.regle: Nothing is made up: an agent moves because it is really working (message, task taken, meeting, training, workshop).
immeuble.entree: The live building: watch your agents work
immeuble.banniereAide: Watch your agents work together, right now: {{n}} at work.

regard.sansVerif: No check or source for this work.

ville.resumeTour: {{rendues}} of {{total}} tasks delivered · {{actifs}} agent(s) working right now
ville.ranger: Move tasks without a project here ({{n}})
ville.butProjet: The goal, in one or two sentences (optional)
ville.datesInverses: The end must come after the start.
ville.vide: No project yet: create the first one and it becomes a tower.
ville.legende: One tower per project: it rises with delivered tasks, the scaffolding shows what is left, the crane leaves when it is done. A lit window = an agent who took a task less than 10 minutes ago. Tap a tower to go in.

salle.vide: No meeting yet. To call one, open a room and tap “Meeting”.
salle.pasEncore: The session is not over: the minutes come at the end.
salle.aucuneAction: No action came out of this meeting.
salle.convoquer: To call a meeting: open a room and tap “Meeting”. Each seat is a real participant; the golden ring follows whoever is speaking.

academie.verite: No invented XP or levels: only what Léo actually measures.
academie.aucune: No skill yet. Add some from their profile.

ordinateur.aide: My computer: add this address to the assistant on your computer (Claude in Chrome, Claude desktop). On the board, choose “My computer”: it takes the task, does it in front of you, and asks before sending, paying or deleting anything. Stop it any time.

services.lectureSeule: Agents only read; the token stays in the server vault.
services.gardeAuCoffre: already stored: leave empty to keep it

supabase.aide: Your agents read your project’s status: health, edge functions, region. Create an access token (Account → Access Tokens) with the shortest expiry: it can do more than read; Léo only uses it to read. The project ID is in Project Settings → General.
supabase.branche: Project “{{id}}” connected: health and edge functions.
supabase.champ: Project ID (20 characters, or its …supabase.co address)

cloudflare.aide: Your agents read your Workers and Pages projects. Create a custom token with ONLY these rights: Workers Scripts Read, Pages Read, Account Analytics Read, on your account. The account ID is on the account home page, right-hand column.

vercel.aide: Your agents read your projects and latest deployments. Vercel has no read-only token: a token carries your rights. Scope it to one team with the shortest expiry; Léo only uses it to read. The team ID is in Team Settings → General.

jarvis.accord: Léo listens only when you press this button (or hold Space). Your sentence is transcribed to understand the order, then the audio is kept nowhere. Sending outside Léo, paying or deleting is never done by voice.
jarvis.pasDeMicro: This browser gives no access to the microphone.
jarvis.demandeRapport: @{{nom}} your report: where are you, what’s done, what’s blocking you?
jarvis.atelierFerme: The workshop is for the company owner only.
jarvis.lecteur: You’re a reader in this company: I can’t do that.

ciel.chaud: It's {{t}} in {{ville}}: remember to drink some water.

equipe.sommeilPourquoi: Their role is defined. We wake them when there is enough to keep them busy — each one costs.

learn.title: Learn

publier.quoi: A photo, a price, a few words. That is what makes your shop exist.

kit.title: Free kit
kit.heading: Keep track of your stock and cash
kit.lead: A ready-to-fill workbook and a one-page guide to know, every evening, how much you sold, what is in the till and what is running out on the shelf.
kit.forWho: For a shop, a pharmacy, a garage, a workshop, a restaurant — in the currency of your choice.
kit.sheetHint: Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice or Numbers
kit.guideHint: One page: the morning and evening routine

articles.name: Items
articles.desc: Your purchase and selling prices, stock that calculates itself, and “Reorder” when it runs low.

entrees.name: Stock received
entrees.desc: Every delivery received, and what you still owe suppliers.

ventes.name: Daily sales
ventes.desc: One row per sale: the price fills itself in, and so does the margin.

caisse.name: Daily cash
caisse.desc: The morning float, the cash counted in the evening, and the difference to explain.

recap.name: Summary
recap.desc: The day, the month, the stock value: where you stand, at a glance.

guide.name: The one-page guide
guide.desc: 10 minutes a day: the routine, the 5 mistakes that lose money, and when to move to a tool.

kit.how1: Type your currency in the yellow “My currency” box: you choose it, the workbook assumes none.
kit.how2: Copy in your items and count what is on the shelf: that is your opening stock. Delete the EXAMPLE rows.
kit.how3: Every evening, count the till. The workbook tells you if anything is missing.
kit.privacy: Nothing to give to get it: no email address, no account. The file stays with you.

kit.nextBody: The same method, with nothing to copy out, and shared if several of you run the till.
